text:
Kyoto Station has two "Central" exits.
Only one leads to the city buses 👇

🚌 Karasuma side (north)
City buses, Kyoto Tower, taxis, subway.
Leave by the Central exit.

🚄 Hachijo side (south)
The Shinkansen side.
Kintetsu to Nara is right in front.
Airport buses leave from the Hachijo exit.

⚠️ The trap
"Shinkansen Central" is not
the bus-side Central exit.

🧳 Bags
Smart lockers on the Hachijo side from ¥400.
Drop by 11:00, at your hotel around 18:00.

👉 Save the exit card:
